Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (CHEMBL224). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL224 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
